prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters, simple rounded people with big round eyes, small dot pupils and overbites, flat colour and black outlines everywhere except the faces, which are rendered with startling real skin: pores, stubble, sweat, tired wet eyes. Every flat colour is laid on with thick visible oil brushstrokes. Only the bodies, clothes and places are cartoon: every face in the frame, however small, is painted as real human skin with wrinkles, pores, bags under the eyes and real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, and no feature is exaggerated. Looking straight up from inside a storm drain through the bars of its iron grate in the gutter of a 1930s city square: a flurry of blank white envelopes flutters down towards us on the wind, the nearest already slipping through the bars. At the edges of the grate, the reaching hands and upturned faces of a crowd, young and old, men and women, Black, white and South Asian. High above them on a stone balcony, small against the grey sky, a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a gold chain flings another handful. Wet stone, dark water dripping. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
